chapter.name: 空塔登舟处
limitations: Index slot499 is retained as the object default TLK entry; it must not be used as an automatic map-load event. Header +0x8A controls map setup; +0x13A controls map-entry TLK.
TLK record kind/mutation numbers are raw native values; dialogue text alone does not define their behavior.

source.coordinate_rule: first native sorted marker cell <<3, then native coordinate x2; no center offset

exits_by_map.execution: Native transition descriptor only; map-entry TLK/ANM and their once-only checks must complete separately.
limitations: Static source/code evidence; original timing not observed
Continuous keyboard movement is runtime policy

texts.M29012:TLK:1: 这位客人对不起，您并没有购买空浮舟的票，我不能让您登舟，如果您想搭乘往飘城的空浮舟可以在我们一楼的售票柜台登记买票，谢谢。
texts.M29012:TLK:2: 您想要搭乘往飘城的空浮舟了吗？
texts.M29012:TLK:5: 力城守卫：自从魔王复活后，其它城镇纷纷关闭空塔，所以力城来往的人就变少了！
